g.text: Upper-stage hydraulic power by grantor after the return (estimate, fixed at expiry) [R08 p3]
Unlabelled segments, left to right: Canton du Valais 2.4 % · Chippis 2.2 % · Chalais 0.6 %. Canton may raise its stake to 31.7 % via its purchase right [R08 p8].
• Upper stage (Moiry, Tourtemagne, Lona, Mottec, Vissoie) returns to the grantors on 31 Dec 2039 for an indemnity of 15.05 MCHF, at most ≈ 20 MCHF (R08 p1, p7; R09 p3). The Navizence stage
stays under the 2004 concession to 2084 (R07 p5).
• Flows assume today's residual-flow rules and a mean year (10-yr mean inflow 265.5 hm³, plant volumes from BFE WASTA ÷ energy coefficients; R07 p8; R10; R06 p8–10). The future concession and
operating rules are not yet decided (R09 p3).
• VS message gives 450 GWh/yr mean upper-stage production (R08 p7); WASTA expects 355 GWh for Mottec + Vissoie + Lona. Moiry raising (≈ 9 m, new Mottec pump) would need a separate convention
• Grey bands: water not turbined (calibration against WASTA), Vissoie spill (≈ 20 hm³ in 2001, R12), and runoff not captured (BAFU MQN, indicative).
Edge width ∝ annual volume; values in hm³/yr (million m³). Plant volumes are the same water used in series. Reference IDs [R##] are listed in EVIDENCE.md.
